dishes.name: Hallorenkugeln
dishes.desc: Chocolate balls with a filling, made in Halle since 1804 and named for the salt boilers. Found in local shops.

dishes.name: Quarkkeulchen
dishes.desc: Fried patties of potato and quark with cinnamon sugar and apple sauce. A Saxon-Anhalt dessert found in Halle restaurants.

dishes.name: Mansfelder Butterkuchen
dishes.desc: Yeast sheet cake topped with butter, sugar and almonds. A bakery staple of the Mansfeld region.

dishes.name: Hausmacher Leberwurst
dishes.desc: Home-style liver sausage of the Halle region, spread on bread at the butcher's counter.
